report: I applied SAVE30 and VIP30 together and checkout gave me 60% off. Our combined discount is only supposed to go up to 50%.
Buying one Sticker and one Enamel Pin shows tax of 16 cents, but tax on the $2.02 subtotal should round to 17 cents.
The Coffee Mug has five units in stock, but checkout still accepts a cart containing six mugs.
